questions: What CLI changes are needed for HTML report support?
Should a new HTML parsing dependency be added?

answers.answer: Three steps: (1) add filePath to the local LibraryItemDetail type, (2) add dual-pattern heading extraction in show.ts - HTML heading regex first, Markdown regex as fallback, (3) run TypeScript compilation. Only show.ts needs changes. All comment commands are format-agnostic.
evidence: show.ts line 46: current Markdown heading regex /^(#{1,6})\s+(.+)$/
show.ts lines 4-9: local LibraryItemDetail type lacks filePath

answers.answer: No. The CLI has zero runtime dependencies by design. A simple regex /<h([1-6])(?:\s+[^>]*?id="([^"]*)"[^>]*)?>(.+?)<\/h\1>/i reliably extracts heading level, id, and text from well-formed HTML headings. Adding a full HTML parser for one regex replacement would be over-engineering.
evidence: package.json: zero runtime dependencies (devDependencies only: typescript, @types/node)
tech-research: Architecture Decision 1 - dual regex chosen over HTML parsing library

statement: The CLI implementation plan covers 3 atomic steps: add filePath to the local type, add dual-pattern heading extraction (HTML regex first, Markdown fallback), and pass TypeScript compilation. Zero new dependencies. Only show.ts is modified.
